titleText: Abela says EU budget financing and fairness still need work after revised plan
mainText: From Times of Malta: Abela says EU budget financing and fairness still need work after revised plan. Prime Minister says the revised draft addresses some Maltese concerns, but Cohesion funding and national flexibility remain priorities

titleText: SDM wins MCAST student council elections for first time
mainText: From Times of Malta: SDM wins MCAST student council elections for first time. Student organisation now controls all four student councils it contests

titleText: Mental health and wellbeing at the heart of education, says Minister Byron Camilleri
mainText: From The Malta Independent: Mental health and wellbeing at the heart of education, says Minister Byron Camilleri. Education can only succeed if mental health and wellbeing are placed at the centre of everything done for both students and educators, Minister for Education and Sport Byron Camilleri said during the second edition of the national conference EduVoices. Held under the theme 'Your Voice.

titleText: KM Malta Airlines and Air India introduce single-ticket travel between Malta and India
mainText: From The Malta Independent: KM Malta Airlines and Air India introduce single-ticket travel between Malta and India. Travellers flying between Malta and India will be able to book their entire journey on a single ticket through Air India from 1 December 2026, following a new codeshare agreement with KM Malta Airlines.

titleText: PN calls for urgent talks after higher hotel licence fees announced without consultation
mainText: From MaltaToday: PN calls for urgent talks after higher hotel licence fees announced without consultation. The Nationalist Party has called for urgent talks with tourism operators after the government announced higher hotel licence fees without what the party called proper consultation.
